value.name: Daniel announces buyer walkthrough
value.description: Daniel says the buyers want a walkthrough on Thursday, raising the urgency around the hidden compartment.
evidence: "The buyers want a walkthrough Thursday," Daniel went on, more to the room than to either of them

value.name: Asha realizes compartment must be opened now
value.description: Asha understands that the contents of the compartment must be removed immediately while Daniel is present or not at all that day.
evidence: Asha understood that whatever was inside the compartment would have to be taken out with him standing there or not taken out at all today.

value.name: Rosa blocks Daniel from the sideboard
value.description: Rosa steps between Daniel and the sideboard, using her body to cover the open panel and create space for Asha.
evidence: Rosa moved before Asha did, stepping with the cloth still in her hand into the line between Daniel and the sideboard, her shoulder catching the edge of the open panel so that her body covered the gap.

value.name: Rosa raises water mark issue
value.description: Rosa distracts Daniel by mentioning a water mark under the leaf and asking to discuss it before Thursday.
evidence: "There's a water mark under the leaf, Daniel, I want to ask you about it before Thursday," she said

value.name: Rosa signals Asha to act
value.description: Rosa gives Asha a subtle look on the word Thursday, silently prompting her to make the next move.
evidence: and on the word Thursday she let her eyes flick once to Asha, a small steadying look that asked for the next move.

value.name: Asha questions property deeds
value.description: Asha stands and asks Daniel whether his mother made any updates to the property deeds before the sale.
evidence: Asha rose from her crouch in the same beat

"While we're all here," she said to Daniel, keeping her voice in the register she used for clients she did not yet trust, "did your mother mention any updates to the property deeds in the last few months, anything she wanted changed before the sale went forward?"

value.name: Daniel hesitates after Asha's question
value.description: Daniel looks between Rosa and Asha and does not answer immediately, revealing that Asha's question has alerted him to something she meant to conceal.
evidence: Daniel's coat was still buttoned; he looked from Rosa's cloth to Asha's hand and did not answer at once, and in that pause Asha understood that the question itself had told him something she had not meant to give away yet.
